items.title: Narvin Kimball Interview, 1961-11-25
items.q: seemingly he was dissatisfied with, uh, uh, my father and me as musicians. And, uh, he influenced fate to the extent that we were given our notice.

ctx.x: I didn't know him. Yeah. And, uh, Charlie Creff was quite a celebrity then. He had done, uh, quite a few recordings. And when he came down, seemingly he was dissatisfied with, uh, uh, my father and me as musicians. And, uh, he influenced fate to the extent that we were given our notice.
He probably won some of his St. Louis friends.
